product_overview: Warrior App is a comprehensive Flutter-based fitness workout management application designed to empower fitness enthusiasts by allowing them to create, manage, and track personalized workout routines. It provides an organized exercise library by muscle groups, custom and predefined workout sets, nutrition and supplements guidance, and advanced features such as offline-first architecture and smart synchronization for seamless user experience.
core_goals: Enable users to browse and explore exercises organized by muscle groups with detailed instructions and videos.
Allow users to create, edit, and manage personalized workout routines including adding/removing exercises and tracking progress.
Provide predefined workout routines tailored to different fitness goals and experience levels.
Implement a calories calculator that uses user data to provide daily caloric needs and macronutrient breakdowns with visual charts.
Offer nutritional and supplements guides to support users' fitness goals with relevant dietary information.
Ensure app functionality is fully accessible offline with automatic synchronization when online.
Provide secure and flexible user authentication through email/password and Google OAuth integration.
Deliver a responsive and engaging user interface with onboarding, animations, and custom UI components.
Integrate monetization via Google Mobile Ads while maintaining user experience.
Implement robust error tracking, logging, and validation to ensure app stability and reliability.
key_features: User Authentication with email/password, Google Sign-In, OTP verification, and secure token storage.
Onboarding flow with welcome screens introducing app features to first-time users.
Home dashboard providing navigation to muscle groups, workouts, calorie calculator, supplements, and nutrition.
Muscle Groups browsing with exercise filtering, searching, and detailed exercise views including videos.
Custom Workout management to create, edit, and share workout routines and import shared workouts.
Predefined Workouts categorized based on fitness goals and experience levels.
Calories Calculator that computes daily caloric and macronutrient needs with interactive charts.
Nutrition Guide providing dietary recommendations and meal plans for fitness enthusiasts.
Supplements Guide offering detailed information about fitness supplements and usage.
Offline-first architecture with Hive local database caching and smart synchronization.
Network layer with Dio client, API handling, error management, and connectivity monitoring.
App navigation using GoRouter with custom transitions, authentication guards, and deep linking.
Comprehensive logging and error tracking with Talker and Sentry integrations.
Google Mobile Ads integration including banner, interstitial, native, and app open ads.
UI components library with custom widgets and form validation utilities.
App initialization with Firebase, Hive, and shared preferences setup.
Theme and styling with Material Design 3, responsive layouts, and custom fonts.
In-app review prompting and force update checks to enhance user engagement and compliance.
user_flow_summary: User opens the app for the first time and completes the onboarding flow highlighting app features.
User registers or logs in using email/password or Google Sign-In with options for password reset and OTP verification.
User lands on the Home Dashboard with access to muscle groups, workouts, calories calculator, supplements, and nutrition sections.
User browses Muscle Groups, selects exercises, views detailed instructions and videos, and filters by muscle type.
User creates a Custom Workout by selecting exercises, adding weights and notes, saving, sharing, or importing workout plans.
User explores Predefined Workouts categorized by goals and experience levels and can start using them directly.
User uses the Calories Calculator by inputting personal data and viewing macronutrient breakdown with graphs.
User accesses Nutrition and Supplements guides for dietary information relevant to fitness goals.
App operates offline fully using cached data and synchronizes seamlessly when internet connectivity is restored.
User encounters ads integrated within the app which are managed to maximize revenue without disrupting user experience.
User receives prompts for app reviews at appropriate times and is forced to update the app if required for compliance or new features.
validation_criteria: All authentication flows including signup, login, Google Sign-In, OTP verification, password reset, and secure token storage must succeed with proper error handling.
Onboarding flows should display correctly and transition smoothly for first-time users only.
Home Dashboard should load all key navigation points accurately with responsive UI elements.
Muscle group listing and exercise detail screens must correctly display data fetched from repositories with filters and search working reliably.
Custom workout creation, editing, deletion, sharing, and import must persist data locally and sync correctly when online.
Predefined workouts must be categorized and retrievable with appropriate details shown.
Calories calculator input validation and calculation results including macronutrient charts should be accurate and visibly clear.
Nutrition and supplements guides must load content offline and refresh data properly when online.
The app must function fully offline with cached data and synchronize changes automatically when connectivity returns without data conflicts.
Network requests should handle errors gracefully and provide user feedback for connectivity issues.
All major features must integrate Google Mobile Ads where appropriate without crashing or degrading performance.
Logging of critical errors should be captured in Sentry and debug logs available via Talker for developers.
UI components must validate form inputs with real-time feedback following defined validation rules.
App must prompt for reviews intelligently and force update dialogs must appear when required, preventing usage of outdated versions.
Automated unit, widget, and integration test suites should pass to ensure code reliability and coverage.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User authentication system with email/password login, Google OAuth, signup, password reset, OTP verification, and secure token storage using Firebase Auth and Flutter Secure Storage

features.name: Onboarding
features.description: Welcome screen and onboarding flow for first-time users with smooth page transitions and introduction to app features

features.name: Home Dashboard
features.description: Main dashboard with navigation to all major features including muscle groups, workouts, calories calculator, supplements, and nutrition

features.name: Muscle Groups & Exercises
features.description: Browse exercises organized by muscle groups, view exercise details with videos and instructions, filter and search exercises by muscle type

features.name: Custom Workouts
features.description: Create, edit, and manage personalized workout routines. Add/remove exercises, track weights, share workout plans with shareable links, and import shared workouts

features.name: Predefined Workouts
features.description: Browse and use professionally designed workout routines categorized by fitness goals and experience levels

features.name: Calories Calculator
features.description: Calculate daily caloric needs based on user data (age, weight, height, activity level, fitness goals). Display macronutrient breakdown with interactive charts

features.name: Nutrition Guide
features.description: Browse nutritional information, meal plans, and dietary guidelines for fitness enthusiasts

features.name: Supplements Guide
features.description: Information about fitness supplements, usage recommendations, and benefits for various workout goals

features.name: Offline Sync Service
features.description: Smart synchronization system that caches data locally using Hive database and syncs with backend when online. Provides offline-first architecture with automatic conflict resolution

features.name: Network Layer
features.description: HTTP client configuration with Dio including interceptors, error handling, logging, and API endpoint management

features.name: Local Storage Services
features.description: Persistent data storage using Hive for offline data, SharedPreferences for app settings, and Flutter Secure Storage for sensitive authentication tokens

features.name: App Navigation & Routing
features.description: GoRouter-based navigation system with custom page transitions, deep linking support for shared workouts, authentication guards, and route observers

features.name: Logging & Error Tracking
features.description: Comprehensive logging with Talker for debugging and Sentry integration for production error tracking and performance monitoring

features.name: Advertising Integration
features.description: Google Mobile Ads integration with app open ads, banner ads, interstitial ads, and native ads for monetization

features.name: UI Components Library
features.description: Reusable custom widgets including buttons, text fields, loaders, animations, error widgets, and offline indicators

features.name: Form Validation
features.description: Input validation utilities for email, password, phone numbers, and other form fields with real-time feedback

features.name: App Services Initialization
features.description: Centralized app initialization including Firebase, Hive database setup, shared preferences, and service configuration

features.name: Theme & Styling
features.description: Material Design 3 theming with custom colors, typography, responsive design using ScreenUtil, and custom fonts (Cairo, Kings, Poppins)

features.name: In-App Review System
features.description: Smart prompting system for app reviews using in_app_review package with appropriate timing and frequency controls

features.name: Force Update Check
features.description: Version verification system that checks for required app updates and prompts users to update when necessary
